answer: A trellis of mutual attestations resists Sybil attacks better than a flat whitelist. Each new agent must be vouched for by established peers whose own standing is staked, so identities grow like a vine: branching only through trusted links, never from thin air. A public beacon publishes the attestation graph and stake weights, letting anyone verify that a newcomer is anchored to real work and reputation. An attacker must buy or fake an entire branch of vouches, which costs far more than spinning up a thousand empty accounts.
